audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 and levels 4-5 were scored Gangplank and Skill while whys[1] literally opens 'Level 2 is Zaahen's' and whys[3] opens 'Levels 4-5 are his again'. Level 3 was scored Gangplank while whys[2] says it 'flattens back to even'.
audit.why: 48.31% over 2068 games: he owns two early windows, you take over from Sheen. The packet chart (Skill, Zaahen, Skill, Zaahen, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank) matches the prose exactly and the level chart did not.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the packet chart, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zaahen's passive is never mentioned anywhere on the page. Riot's text: 'Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination... When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.'
audit.why: A revive plus a bonus-AD spike is the single most important thing to read before committing a keg chain, and the page's advice ('commit the full pattern immediately') is actively wrong into a full bar.
audit.corrected: Determination written into tldr, tradeBad, phases[6].why and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole matchup refers to his abilities as 'Ultimate' and 'his combo' — focus.text is the string 'Zaahen Ultimate' and every cooldown line says 'Track Ultimate'. No ability of his is named, and the packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: His actual kit has three separate answers to your pattern: The Darkin Glaive (Q) is an auto reset that heals and knocks up on recast, his W pulls you in from 850 range, and Aureate Rush (E) dashes on an 8-10s cooldown with percent-health damage so armour alone reads the trade wrong. Grim Deliverance (R) heals off the damage it deals on a 110s cooldown at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written across the phases, do's, don'ts and trade rules, giving the page the 'wait for X before you Y' lines the packet says are missing.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E/R cd, range and text
missingInteractions headlines for the Q, E and R names

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] carries no anti-heal line for this matchup and no don't mentions it.
audit.why: Both his Q and his R heal him, and his E deals percent-health damage — so stacking armour is the wrong instinct and Grievous Wounds is the right one. Both flagged as missing interactions and both absent.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal put on phases[4].why, and the percent-health caveat into the E lines.
